summary: Waldur 8.1.3-rc.20 brings large changes to calls for proposals. Call managers can now export a call's configuration and import it on another portal. They can also export proposals and reviews as CSV and download a proposal as PDF, and a call's evaluation can start at the round cut-off. Reviewer assignment limits are now enforced, and reviewer pool invitations expire on every invitation path. The legacy project-duration fields are removed. In the marketplace, providers can derive component limits from order-form formulas and sums, and the order form shows the derived limits and their price. Offering options can also require values that are unique across resources and be checked against the provider's pattern. Other changes: approvers and requesters get emails about resource end date change requests, owners can create Matrix rooms and existing projects can be backfilled, VMware orders pass the chosen networks and folder to the VM, Brreg is available as an onboarding validation method, and several Constance settings were removed or renamed. The admin menus are regrouped into tabbed pages, the UI continues its move to the Tailwind/Radix component library with a new date picker, and several fixes cover proposal workflows, FreeIPA, Zammad sync and usage reporting. Python and JavaScript dependencies were also bumped.

entries.title: Accessibility and keyboard navigation fixes
entries.description: Fixed WCAG 2.2 AA findings from an axe-core scan across tables, sidebar, tabs and forms. Pressing Enter on a link without an onClick handler, or on a read-only avatar strip, no longer throws an error. The My Access Requests view switch is now a keyboard-operable radio group, and the sign-in method switch uses accessible tabs.

entries.title: AI assistant display fixes
entries.description: Mermaid diagrams in AI assistant replies now fit the chat bubble. The conversation marker now stays on the AI assistant button.

entries.title: Attribute call-allocated orders to a real person
entries.description: Previously, orders placed when a call allocated resources were not attributed to a real person. Now, these orders are attributed to a person and flagged as placed automatically. The call's support ticket caller option is renamed to order author.

actions.description: Marketplace migration 0297_order_placed_automatically adds an automatic-placement flag to orders. Proposal migration 0081 renames the support ticket caller option to order author.

entries.title: Audit changes to role definitions
entries.description: Previously, changes to role definitions were not audited. Now, they are logged as events and shown in the audit feed.

entries.title: Bump anyio and soupsieve dependencies
entries.description: Previously, the pinned versions of anyio and soupsieve were flagged by the OSV scan. Now, both are upgraded to clear those findings.

entries.title: Change limits shows correct usage and prepaid pricing
entries.description: The Change limits view showed incorrect usage values and priced prepaid limit changes over the wrong period. It now shows correct usage and prices prepaid limit changes over the resource's actual remaining months.

entries.title: Configure applicant eligibility from the call UI
entries.description: Previously, applicant eligibility restrictions could not be configured from the call UI. Now, the call page has an eligibility section for setting them.

entries.title: Consistent alerts, toast notifications and dialog button order
entries.description: Previously, alerts and toast notifications were built on Bootstrap components, and dialog buttons did not follow a consistent order. Now, toast notifications are rebuilt on the design system, alerts use the shared AlertItem component, and dialog buttons follow an enforced order.

entries.title: Context-aware changelog system
entries.description: Previously, deployments had no machine-readable way to show staff what an upgrade brings. Now, a new changelog app assembles structured release changelogs, serves them through an API, and exposes version metadata. Each change is shown only once across a release candidate cycle.

actions.description: Initial migration for the new waldur_core.changelog app.

entries.title: Dark mode and login layout theming fixes
entries.description: Dark mode styles now use the correct theme attribute on login layouts. Mermaid charts take their colours from design tokens and display correctly in dark mode. The provider ticket assignee picker is themed for dark mode, and login footer links are readable on gradient layouts.

entries.title: Email diagnostics handle display-name sender addresses
entries.description: Email diagnostics did not work correctly when the sender address included a display name. Such addresses are now handled.

entries.title: Limits column in the marketplace orders list
entries.description: Previously, the marketplace orders list did not show order limits. Now, it has a Limits column.

entries.title: Log when a notification drop silences a mail
entries.description: Previously, a mail suppressed by a notification drop was skipped with no log entry. Now, a log entry is written when this happens.

entries.title: Menus, popovers and drawers no longer overlap or get cut off
entries.description: Header popovers now appear above the fixed toolbar. Select menus stay clickable inside the modal drawer. Floating drawers stay under the header and their toggles keep working. Tall actions menus are capped to the window height and scroll instead of running off-screen.

entries.title: Offering import and export keep values intact and reject invalid input
entries.description: Offering import now normalises null values and rejects invalid input. Offering export now keeps empty units and zero amounts instead of dropping them.

entries.title: Only staff and support can create support requests on behalf of others
entries.description: Creating a support request on behalf of another user is now limited to staff and support users.

entries.title: Operator-editable language list in Docker Compose
entries.description: Previously, Docker Compose deployments could not change the language list. Now, config/waldur-mastermind/languages.yaml is mounted into the containers so operators can edit it.

entries.title: Order form fixes for offering switching, default limits and closed steps
entries.description: The order form now updates correctly when the offering is switched inside it. It keeps the offering's default limits when the form is reinitialised, and gives a single consistent reason for why its steps are closed.

entries.title: Outbound SCIM entitlements gated behind an offering option
entries.description: Previously, outbound SCIM entitlements were not controlled per offering. Now, they are sent only for offerings where the new integration option is enabled. The option can be set in the offering's user management settings.

actions.description: Enable the outbound SCIM entitlements option on each offering that should keep pushing SCIM entitlements.

entries.title: Project chat rooms: one actions menu and no switcher showing other projects' rooms
entries.description: Previously, the chat drawer had a room switcher that listed rooms from other projects, and project chat room actions were shown as separate controls. Now, the switcher is removed and the room actions are grouped in one menu.

entries.title: Refused restore returns the resource to the terminated state
entries.description: When a restore order was refused, the resource did not return to its previous state. It now goes back to the terminated state.

entries.title: Removing a project grant sends the correct project
entries.description: Removing a project grant from the organization team list did not send the actual project UUID. It now does.

entries.title: Resolve duplicate per-tenant OpenStack offerings with the merge engine
entries.description: Previously, duplicate per-tenant OpenStack offerings had to be handled without the offering merge engine. Now, they are resolved through the merge engine, both from the dedupe_tenant_offerings management command and from a duplicate offerings API with a resolve action in the staff UI.

actions.description: Deployments with duplicate per-tenant OpenStack offerings can review and resolve them with the dedupe_tenant_offerings management command or the staff duplicate offerings view.

entries.title: Route guard and navigation fixes
entries.description: Permission gates could run before the workspace was resolved; they now wait for it. When a route guard refuses access, the denied address is now kept. Clicking a parent tab now opens its first child page.

entries.title: Service desk defaults reconcile a mistyped status
entries.description: The init_service_desk_defaults command skipped seeding when a status had the wrong type. It now corrects the existing status instead.

entries.title: Show measured units for requested resource amounts
entries.description: Previously, requested resource amounts in order summaries, plan rows and call resource requests were shown without their measured units. Now, the units are shown.

entries.title: Staff offering merge tool with preview, background execution and undo
entries.description: Previously, there was no supported way to combine duplicate marketplace offerings. Now, a merge engine records each merge, previews the rows it will change grouped by area, runs the merge in the background, applies an invoice snapshot policy, checks the result after the merge, and supports undo. A staff API and a new UI provide a merge wizard, merge history, merge details, grouped preview tables with drill-down, and a dialog with verification details. Merge progress is reported through new events.

actions.description: Marketplace migrations 0294_offering_merge and 0295_offering_merge_progress add the offering merge record and progress tracking.

entries.title: Stop logging plan component price updates that changed nothing
entries.description: Plan component price updates were logged even when nothing changed, including during remote offering sync. These no-op updates are no longer logged, and a data migration removes the existing no-op price logs.

actions.description: Marketplace migration 0296_clean_noop_price_logs removes existing log entries for price updates that changed nothing.

entries.title: Store VMware datastore sizes in 64-bit columns
entries.description: VMware datastore capacity and free space were stored in columns too small for large datastores. They are now stored in 64-bit columns.

actions.description: VMware migration 0030 changes the datastore capacity and free_space columns to 64-bit integers.

entries.title: Advertise the SRAM SCIM profile on its own discovery endpoints
entries.description: Previously, the SRAM SCIM profile was not advertised on its own discovery endpoints. Now, SRAM has dedicated SCIM discovery endpoints that advertise its profile.

entries.title: Authors can edit and delete their own support comments
entries.description: Previously, users could not edit or delete support comments they had written, and the UI could show comment actions the user was not allowed to take. Now, comment authors can edit and delete their own comments, and staff are notified when a comment is updated. The UI shows comment actions only where the user may take them.

entries.title: Bound course-account API calls with a timeout and close accounts asynchronously
entries.description: Previously, course-account API calls had no explicit timeout. Now, they are bounded by an explicit timeout. The course account delete action in the UI reflects that the account is closed asynchronously.

entries.title: Browse changelog releases and generate upgrade reports in the backend
entries.description: Previously, the backend could not list changelog releases, and it did not build the upgrade report, announcement or commands. Now, the backend lists changelog releases and lets you browse what any release introduced. It also builds the upgrade report, announcement and commands. Changelog entries can be filtered by category and sorted by any column.

entries.title: Choose who a call's resource orders are created by
entries.description: Previously, the call configuration did not let you choose who creates the call's resource orders. Now, the call's general configuration section includes this setting.

entries.title: Clear service provider comment when an offering user becomes OK
entries.description: Previously, a service provider comment stayed on an offering user after the user reached the OK state. Now, the comment is cleared when the offering user becomes OK.

entries.title: Clear stored invitation token when closing a non-pending invitation dialog
entries.description: The stored invitation token was kept after the user closed the dialog for an invitation that was no longer pending. The token is now cleared when that dialog is closed.

entries.title: Configurable About us page linked from the footer
entries.description: Previously, there was no About us page. Now, administrators can configure its content in the branding settings with a Markdown editor, and the page is linked from the footer.

entries.title: Download issue template files with the API token
entries.description: Issue template attachment files were downloaded without the API token. They are now downloaded with the API token.

entries.title: Every reviewer invitation gets a working link and email
entries.description: Some reviewer pool invitations had no working link and did not send an email. Every reviewer invitation now gets a default token, a working link and an email.

actions.description: Apply proposal migration 0082_reviewer_pool_invitation_token_default.

entries.title: Filter offering users and provider accounts by username
entries.description: Previously, offering users and provider accounts could not be filtered by username. Now, the API supports a username filter for both.

entries.title: Fix mobile notifications drawer and navigation issues
entries.description: On mobile, the notifications drawer did not open correctly, and there was a gap below the navbar. Both issues have been fixed. Parent tabs now point to the first entry their submenu actually shows.

entries.title: Fix offering option editing and numeric input fields
entries.description: The dialogs and wizard for adding, editing and deleting offering options had problems, as did the shared numeric input field used in several forms. These components have been fixed.

entries.title: Fix open calls dashboard link filter
entries.description: The open calls link on the call management dashboard applied the wrong filter. The link now applies the correct filter.

entries.title: Fix profile page crash caused by the recalculate user actions button
entries.description: The recalculate user actions button could crash the profile page. The crash has been fixed.

entries.title: Hide the anonymous chat tab while anonymous chat is disabled
entries.description: The support AI assistant dashboard showed the anonymous chat tab even when anonymous chat was disabled. The tab is now hidden in that case.

entries.title: Keyboard accessibility and consistent focus rings
entries.description: Previously, some controls could only be used with a mouse, keyboard navigation in global search did not work correctly, and focus indicators were inconsistent. Now, every focusable element has the brand focus ring, including tabs. The Add filter menu, breadcrumb dropdowns, the marketplace categories popup and search items can be reached with the keyboard. Global search keyboard navigation has been fixed, profile View/Edit controls are treated as buttons, and the Continue button in the OpenStack discovery wizard has an accessible name.

entries.title: Name SCIM accounts after the match value as sent so logins find them
entries.description: Accounts provisioned through SCIM were not named after the match value exactly as sent, so logins could fail to find them. Accounts are now named after the match value as sent. The find_username_collisions management command has also been updated.

entries.title: Offer newer release candidates to deployments running an RC
entries.description: Previously, deployments running a release candidate were not offered newer release candidates. Now, the version check and changelog offer them newer release candidates as available upgrades.

entries.title: Retry OpenStack instance delete polls on Nova HTTP 429
entries.description: When Nova returned HTTP 429 (rate limited) while the backend was polling an instance deletion, the poll was not retried. These polls are now retried.

entries.title: Serve user avatars without requiring an authenticated request
entries.description: User avatars were only served to authenticated requests, so they could fail to display. Avatars are now served without authentication.

entries.title: Show end date change request reasons in an expandable row
entries.description: Previously, the reasons for resource and project end date change requests were not shown in an expandable row. Now, they are shown in an expandable table row.

entries.title: Show reviews due soon instead of overdue reviews on the dashboard
entries.description: Previously, the proposal dashboard had a card for overdue reviews. Now, that card is replaced by one showing reviews that are due soon.

entries.title: Stringify Celery exception results before writing error_message
entries.description: Celery exception results were written to error_message without first being converted to strings. They are now converted to strings before they are stored.

entries.title: Thread support notification emails
entries.description: Previously, support notification emails for a ticket were not grouped into threads. Now, these emails are threaded, and the subject templates for comment, issue update, feedback and provider escalation notifications have been updated. A provider ticket withdrawn notification template has also been added.

entries.title: Validate free-form offering options against a provider pattern
entries.description: Previously, free-form offering option values could not be checked against a format. Now, service providers can define a pattern, and free-form option values are validated against it.

entries.title: Bulk CSV invitations use roles loaded after the dialog opens
entries.description: In the invitation dialog, CSV bulk upload filled roles only from the roles that were available when the dialog opened, so roles loaded afterwards were missed. It now uses the roles that load after the dialog opens.

entries.title: Changelog page, security alert banner and footer version badge
entries.description: Previously, the frontend had no way to show release changelog information. Now, it adds a changelog page under Administration with a release picker, expandable entries, a toolbar and filters, and dialogs for upgrade commands and upgrade scheduling. It also adds a changelog summary dialog, a security alert banner and a changelog badge in the app footer.

entries.title: Cost policies are not evaluated when a save only updates last_sync
entries.description: Previously, cost policies were evaluated on every save, including saves that only updated the `last_sync` field, and each evaluation was logged verbosely. Now, those saves skip cost policy evaluation, and the policy logging is quieter.

entries.title: Default tab is highlighted when a page opens
entries.description: When a page opened on its default tab, that tab was not shown as selected. It is now highlighted.

entries.title: Duplicate-role warnings when adding users and sending invitations
entries.description: Previously, the add-user and invitation dialogs did not warn when a person already held the selected role. Now, the customer and project add-user dialogs and the invitation dialog show a warning for existing roles. In the invitation dialog, each row's verdict is matched to that row's project, and each warning is shown only once.

entries.title: Long dropdown menus scroll and table filters are no longer cut off
entries.description: Long dropdown menus under Administration > Configuration could not be scrolled, and a height limit on popover menu content cut off table filter menus. Long navigation and action dropdowns now scroll, and the height limit on popover menus has been removed.

entries.title: Offering option for robot-account identity
entries.description: Previously, an offering could not record whether it uses robot accounts for identity. Now, offerings have a `plugin_options.uses_robot_accounts` flag. The backend serializer accepts it, the offering documentation describes it, and it can be set in the User Management section of the offering integration settings in the UI.

entries.title: Removed the nested Details card from the user profile editor
entries.description: Previously, the user profile editor showed a Details card nested inside the edit tab. Now, the nested card is gone and the form sits directly in the tab.

entries.title: Role administration merged into one tabbed page
entries.description: Previously, role administration was split across three separate routes. Now, the three routes are one page with tabs, which include the roles list, role availabilities and role hygiene views.

entries.title: Support order description renders when the order has no plan
entries.description: The description of a support order did not render correctly when the order had no plan. The marketplace plan template and template tags now handle orders without a plan.

entries.title: Support users can read call-management data
entries.description: Previously, support users could not read call-management data. Now, the proposal permissions, serializers and views give support users read access to it.

entries.title: Automatic termination orders attributed to the creation order's author
entries.description: Previously, automatically created termination orders, including those created by policy actions, were not attributed to the author of the resource's creation order. Now, they are attributed to that author. The help text of the order's placed-automatically field is updated to match.

actions.description: Marketplace migration 0298_order_placed_automatically_help_text updates the field help text.

entries.title: Call edit controls disabled without UPDATE_CALL permission
entries.description: Previously, users without the UPDATE_CALL permission still saw active edit controls in the call management and update views, including team, rounds, offerings, documents, reviewer pool, role mappings and workflow steps. Now, these controls are disabled for such users.

entries.title: Header tab submenus open from the keyboard
entries.description: Previously, header tab submenus could not be opened with the keyboard. Now, they can be opened and navigated from the keyboard.

entries.title: Layout and navigation fixes
entries.description: Long resource names now wrap inside the resource detail header card instead of overflowing. The request view switch keeps the same size in both lenses. Role redirect routes no longer appear in the Configuration menu.

entries.title: Login authenticates by credentials and renews the session
entries.description: The login endpoint could authenticate a request using an existing session cookie instead of the submitted credentials. It now authenticates by credentials only. The session is also renewed whenever a login records its authentication method, which covers password, SAML2, social and passkey logins.

entries.title: Order tickets name the applicant and project team
entries.description: Previously, support tickets created for marketplace orders did not name the applicant or the project team. Now, the ticket description includes both.

entries.title: Organization owners can see their organization's protected calls
entries.description: Previously, organization owners could not list their organization's protected calls. Now, they can, through a new permission granted to the owner role.

actions.description: Permissions migration 0031_owner_list_calls grants organization owners the right to list calls.

entries.title: Proposal-allocated resources named after project and offering
entries.description: Previously, resources allocated from accepted proposals were not named after their project and offering. Now, their names are built from the project and offering.

entries.title: Pub/sub events for call and proposal state changes
entries.description: Previously, call and proposal state changes were not published as pub/sub events. Now, they are published through the event dispatch system, so agents can subscribe to them.

entries.title: Same-role grant rejected regardless of the existing role's expiry
entries.description: Granting a user a role they already held could get past validation, depending on the existing role's expiry. Such a grant is now rejected whatever the existing role's expiry.

entries.title: Telemetry is now opt-out, with deploy-time switches for Helm and Docker Compose
entries.description: Previously, telemetry was opt-in and its feature gate did not work correctly. Now, telemetry is opt-out, the feature gate is fixed, and a data migration applies the new default. Deployments can set the switch at deploy time with the Helm value `waldur.telemetry.enabled` or the `WALDUR_TELEMETRY_ENABLED` environment variable, which Docker Compose passes to mastermind.

actions.description: Core migration 0051_telemetry_opt_out applies the new telemetry default.
Deployments that do not want telemetry should opt out, using `waldur.telemetry.enabled` in Helm values or `WALDUR_TELEMETRY_ENABLED` in the Docker Compose `.env` file.

entries.title: Add a public-sector accounting demo preset and extend structure import/export
entries.description: Previously, there was no public-sector accounting demo preset, and structure export/import did not include a call's disclosure level and assignment configuration. Now, a public-sector accounting preset is available, export_structure and import_structure handle call disclosure level and assignment configuration, and three preset-loader bugs are fixed.

entries.title: Add KPI definition model for project business KPIs
entries.description: Previously, there was no model for project business KPIs. Now, the marketplace has offering KPI definitions and per-resource KPI values.

actions.description: Migration marketplace 0299_offeringkpi_resourcekpivalue adds the offering KPI and resource KPI value tables.

entries.title: Allow Brreg as an onboarding validation method
entries.description: Previously, Brreg was not an accepted onboarding validation method. Now, it can be selected as one.

entries.title: Allow owners to create Matrix rooms and backfill existing projects
entries.description: Previously, owners could not create Matrix rooms, and existing projects had no rooms. Now, owners have a permission to create Matrix rooms, and a provision_matrix_rooms management command backfills rooms for existing projects. The chat members list is now shown above the chat drawer.

actions.description: Migration permissions 0032_owner_create_matrix_room grants owners the permission to create Matrix rooms.
Run the provision_matrix_rooms management command to backfill Matrix rooms for existing projects.

entries.title: Bump Python and JavaScript dependencies
entries.description: Previously, older versions of several dependencies were pinned. Now, urllib3 is bumped to 2.8.0, oauthlib and pyjwt are bumped to fix OSV scan findings, the undici resolution is bumped to ^7.30.0, and frontend dependencies flagged by the OSV scanner are updated.

entries.title: Clamp set_limits values to the offering bounds
entries.description: Previously, set_limits accepted values outside the offering's bounds. Now, values are clamped to the bounds the offering defines.

entries.title: Derive component limits from order-form formulas and sums
entries.description: Previously, component limits had to be entered directly. Now, offering providers can configure component limits that are derived from order-form option formulas and sums. The order form, limit change dialog and resource options show the derived limits and their price. A paired formula option is kept while resources still hold changed values.

entries.title: Email approvers and requesters about resource end date change requests
entries.description: Previously, no emails were sent about resource end date change requests. Now, approvers are emailed when a request is created, and requesters are emailed when it is approved or rejected.

entries.title: Enforce reviewer assignment limits based on open assignments
entries.description: Previously, reviewers' assignment limits were not counted from their open assignments. Now, the limits are enforced against each reviewer's currently open assignments.

entries.title: Expire reviewer pool invitations on every invitation path
entries.description: Previously, reviewer pool invitations did not expire on every invitation path. Now, they expire on all paths, and a notification email is sent when an invitation expires.

entries.title: Export a call's configuration and import it on another portal
entries.description: Previously, a call's configuration could not be moved between Waldur portals. Now, call managers can export a call's configuration, including its reference code, and import it on another portal. Export and import actions are available from call management in the UI.

entries.title: Export a call's proposals and reviews as CSV and a proposal as PDF
entries.description: Previously, call managers could not export a call's proposals and reviews. Now, the call manager's proposal and review lists support the standard table export. The export dialog can export either the columns on screen or a full CSV report from new backend endpoints. A single proposal can be downloaded as PDF, and compliance status is exported as text. 'Apply table filters' now sends every filter the export understands, including the search box. Proposals now record a submission timestamp.

actions.description: Migration proposal 0085_proposal_submitted_at adds a submission timestamp to proposals.

entries.title: Filter quota analytics by organization
entries.description: Previously, quota analytics could not be filtered by organization. Now, customer and project quota analytics accept an organization filter.

entries.title: Fix 500 error when a FreeIPA username is already taken
entries.description: Creating a FreeIPA profile with a username that was already taken returned a server error (500). The request now returns a proper validation error.

entries.title: Fix layout and display issues across the UI
entries.description: Several display problems are fixed. The sidebar is now offset below the impersonation bar, and custom select options have their full-width layout back. Maintenance datetimes are shown with their timezone, and dashboard chart legends and reference lines follow the theme.

entries.title: Fix OECD project-count chart grouping by the wrong field
entries.description: The OECD project-count chart grouped projects by the wrong field. It now groups by the correct field.

entries.title: Fix resource usage views and filters
entries.description: Resource usage rows were not shown in their billing month, the usage history filters were broken, and usage report tabs could not be switched from the overflow menu. Usage rows now appear in their billing month, the filters work, and the overflow menu switches tabs.

entries.title: Fix reviewer assignment batch emails, reminders and deadline extension
entries.description: Reviewer assignment batches had problems with their invitation emails, expiry reminders and deadline extension. These are fixed, and the batch-expired, expiry-reminder and assignment-invitation email templates were updated.

entries.title: Fix round closing and end-of-round proposal cancellation
entries.description: Closing a round did not save the round, and an already ended round could be closed. The round is now saved when closed, and closing an ended round is refused. Also, when a round ends, only draft proposals are cancelled.

entries.title: Forward VMware order networks and folder to the VM and show powered-off VMs as stopped
entries.description: Previously, the networks and folder chosen in a VMware order were not passed to the created VM, and a powered-off VM was shown with a success state. Now, the chosen networks and folder are forwarded to the VM, templates track their NIC count, and a powered-off VM is shown as stopped.

actions.description: Migration waldur_vmware 0031_template_nic_count adds a NIC count to templates.

entries.title: Group admin menus into tabbed pages
entries.description: Previously, the System management, Marketplace, and Organizations & compliance admin menus listed many separate pages. Now, related pages are grouped into tabbed pages. Tab toolbar controls are also kept when the open tab is clicked again.

entries.title: Handle duplicate Zammad SupportUser rows during comment sync
entries.description: Zammad comment sync failed when duplicate SupportUser rows existed. The sync now handles them.

entries.title: Let the global support role read service provider stats and revenue
entries.description: Previously, the global support role could not read service provider statistics and revenue. Now, it has read access to them.

entries.title: Migrate buttons, accordions and date pickers to the new UI component library
entries.description: Previously, buttons, accordions and date pickers used Bootstrap/Metronic and flatpickr. Now, buttons use Tailwind/shadcn, accordions use the Radix-based waldur-ui library, and flatpickr is replaced by a react-day-picker calendar. This also replaces the earlier fix for the transparent flatpickr background. ScrollSpy navigation, the role permission field and chart export actions also move to shared components, and unused Metronic styles are removed.

entries.title: Notify only the offering managers of a proposal's requested offerings
entries.description: Proposal notifications for offering managers went to a broader group than the managers of the offerings the proposal requested. They now go only to managers of the requested offerings.

entries.title: Prepare Constance settings for replacement
entries.description: Previously, the site logo was stored as a Constance setting, and the LLM chat settings used their old Constance key names. Now, migrations remove the site logo Constance entry and rename the LLM chat Constance keys. Core and marketplace migrations are squashed, and the settings-related management commands (print_settings_description, set_constance_image, set_login_logo_language) are updated.

actions.description: Migrations core 0024_remove_constance_site_logo and 0025_rename_llm_chat_constance_keys update stored Constance values, and marketplace migrations are squashed.
Deployments that set the site logo or LLM chat Constance keys through scripts or configuration should check them against the renamed or removed keys.

entries.title: Remove proposal project duration and its review comment
entries.description: Previously, proposals had a project_duration field and reviews had a comment_project_duration field. Now, both fields are removed from the models, the API serializers, structure import/export and the call management demo preset. The UI no longer shows the project duration review comment.

actions.description: Migration proposal 0083_remove_project_duration drops Proposal.project_duration and Review.comment_project_duration, and their stored data.
API clients or integrations that read or write project_duration or comment_project_duration must be updated.

entries.title: Restrict what reviewers see of proposal teams and assignments
entries.description: The proposal team list ignored the call's applicant visibility setting for reviewers. It now applies that setting. Reviewers also see less about assignments that have not been sent yet or that have a conflict.

entries.title: Show OpenStack instance and tenant names in order tickets
entries.description: Previously, order tickets listed only the UUIDs of OpenStack instances and tenants. Now, their names are shown next to the UUIDs.

entries.title: Show providers the compliance checklist assigned to their offering
entries.description: Previously, service providers could not see the compliance checklist assigned to their offering. Now, the offering exposes the assigned checklist to its provider.

entries.title: Show readable qualifiers for same-named roles
entries.description: Previously, roles with the same name were told apart by machine names in role selectors. Now, readable qualifiers are shown instead, in invitations, project team, auto-provisioning and SRAM rule forms.

entries.title: Show the award confirmation prompt only to the applicant
entries.description: The award confirmation prompt in the proposal workflow timeline was shown to users other than the applicant. It is now shown only to the applicant.

entries.title: Show the impersonated user's token on /users/me again
entries.description: During impersonation, /users/me did not return the impersonated user's token. It now does again.

entries.title: Start a call's evaluation at the round cut-off and add call-manager controls
entries.description: Previously, a call's evaluation could not be configured to start at the round cut-off. Now, a call can be configured to start evaluation at the round cut-off. Call managers also get UI controls for the evaluation start, for resending reviewer invitations and for overriding reviewer workload limits on manual assignment.

actions.description: Migration proposal 0084_call_evaluation_start adds the evaluation start configuration to calls.

entries.title: Switch telemetry off from the Telemetry admin page
entries.description: Previously, telemetry sending could not be switched off from the Telemetry admin page. Now, the page has a control to turn it off.

entries.title: Validate offering option values for uniqueness and provider patterns
entries.description: Previously, offering options could not require unique values, and the UI did not check option values against the provider-configured pattern. Now, an offering option can require its values to be unique across the offering's resources. The order and option forms also check values against the provider's pattern.

since_previous.title: Add a public-sector accounting demo preset and extend structure import/export
since_previous.description: Previously, there was no public-sector accounting demo preset, and structure export/import did not include a call's disclosure level and assignment configuration. Now, a public-sector accounting preset is available, export_structure and import_structure handle call disclosure level and assignment configuration, and three preset-loader bugs are fixed.

since_previous.title: Add KPI definition model for project business KPIs
since_previous.description: Previously, there was no model for project business KPIs. Now, the marketplace has offering KPI definitions and per-resource KPI values.

actions.description: Migration marketplace 0299_offeringkpi_resourcekpivalue adds the offering KPI and resource KPI value tables.

since_previous.title: Allow Brreg as an onboarding validation method
since_previous.description: Previously, Brreg was not an accepted onboarding validation method. Now, it can be selected as one.

since_previous.title: Allow owners to create Matrix rooms and backfill existing projects
since_previous.description: Previously, owners could not create Matrix rooms, and existing projects had no rooms. Now, owners have a permission to create Matrix rooms, and a provision_matrix_rooms management command backfills rooms for existing projects. The chat members list is now shown above the chat drawer.

actions.description: Migration permissions 0032_owner_create_matrix_room grants owners the permission to create Matrix rooms.
Run the provision_matrix_rooms management command to backfill Matrix rooms for existing projects.

since_previous.title: Bump Python and JavaScript dependencies
since_previous.description: Previously, older versions of several dependencies were pinned. Now, urllib3 is bumped to 2.8.0, oauthlib and pyjwt are bumped to fix OSV scan findings, the undici resolution is bumped to ^7.30.0, and frontend dependencies flagged by the OSV scanner are updated.

since_previous.title: Clamp set_limits values to the offering bounds
since_previous.description: Previously, set_limits accepted values outside the offering's bounds. Now, values are clamped to the bounds the offering defines.

since_previous.title: Derive component limits from order-form formulas and sums
since_previous.description: Previously, component limits had to be entered directly. Now, offering providers can configure component limits that are derived from order-form option formulas and sums. The order form, limit change dialog and resource options show the derived limits and their price. A paired formula option is kept while resources still hold changed values.

since_previous.title: Email approvers and requesters about resource end date change requests
since_previous.description: Previously, no emails were sent about resource end date change requests. Now, approvers are emailed when a request is created, and requesters are emailed when it is approved or rejected.

since_previous.title: Enforce reviewer assignment limits based on open assignments
since_previous.description: Previously, reviewers' assignment limits were not counted from their open assignments. Now, the limits are enforced against each reviewer's currently open assignments.

since_previous.title: Expire reviewer pool invitations on every invitation path
since_previous.description: Previously, reviewer pool invitations did not expire on every invitation path. Now, they expire on all paths, and a notification email is sent when an invitation expires.

since_previous.title: Export a call's configuration and import it on another portal
since_previous.description: Previously, a call's configuration could not be moved between Waldur portals. Now, call managers can export a call's configuration, including its reference code, and import it on another portal. Export and import actions are available from call management in the UI.

since_previous.title: Export a call's proposals and reviews as CSV and a proposal as PDF
since_previous.description: Previously, call managers could not export a call's proposals and reviews. Now, the call manager's proposal and review lists support the standard table export. The export dialog can export either the columns on screen or a full CSV report from new backend endpoints. A single proposal can be downloaded as PDF, and compliance status is exported as text. 'Apply table filters' now sends every filter the export understands, including the search box. Proposals now record a submission timestamp.

actions.description: Migration proposal 0085_proposal_submitted_at adds a submission timestamp to proposals.

since_previous.title: Filter quota analytics by organization
since_previous.description: Previously, quota analytics could not be filtered by organization. Now, customer and project quota analytics accept an organization filter.

since_previous.title: Fix 500 error when a FreeIPA username is already taken
since_previous.description: Creating a FreeIPA profile with a username that was already taken returned a server error (500). The request now returns a proper validation error.

since_previous.title: Fix layout and display issues across the UI
since_previous.description: Several display problems are fixed. The sidebar is now offset below the impersonation bar, and custom select options have their full-width layout back. Maintenance datetimes are shown with their timezone, and dashboard chart legends and reference lines follow the theme.

since_previous.title: Fix OECD project-count chart grouping by the wrong field
since_previous.description: The OECD project-count chart grouped projects by the wrong field. It now groups by the correct field.

since_previous.title: Fix resource usage views and filters
since_previous.description: Resource usage rows were not shown in their billing month, the usage history filters were broken, and usage report tabs could not be switched from the overflow menu. Usage rows now appear in their billing month, the filters work, and the overflow menu switches tabs.

since_previous.title: Fix reviewer assignment batch emails, reminders and deadline extension
since_previous.description: Reviewer assignment batches had problems with their invitation emails, expiry reminders and deadline extension. These are fixed, and the batch-expired, expiry-reminder and assignment-invitation email templates were updated.

since_previous.title: Fix round closing and end-of-round proposal cancellation
since_previous.description: Closing a round did not save the round, and an already ended round could be closed. The round is now saved when closed, and closing an ended round is refused. Also, when a round ends, only draft proposals are cancelled.

since_previous.title: Forward VMware order networks and folder to the VM and show powered-off VMs as stopped
since_previous.description: Previously, the networks and folder chosen in a VMware order were not passed to the created VM, and a powered-off VM was shown with a success state. Now, the chosen networks and folder are forwarded to the VM, templates track their NIC count, and a powered-off VM is shown as stopped.

actions.description: Migration waldur_vmware 0031_template_nic_count adds a NIC count to templates.

since_previous.title: Group admin menus into tabbed pages
since_previous.description: Previously, the System management, Marketplace, and Organizations & compliance admin menus listed many separate pages. Now, related pages are grouped into tabbed pages. Tab toolbar controls are also kept when the open tab is clicked again.

since_previous.title: Handle duplicate Zammad SupportUser rows during comment sync
since_previous.description: Zammad comment sync failed when duplicate SupportUser rows existed. The sync now handles them.

since_previous.title: Let the global support role read service provider stats and revenue
since_previous.description: Previously, the global support role could not read service provider statistics and revenue. Now, it has read access to them.

since_previous.title: Migrate buttons, accordions and date pickers to the new UI component library
since_previous.description: Previously, buttons, accordions and date pickers used Bootstrap/Metronic and flatpickr. Now, buttons use Tailwind/shadcn, accordions use the Radix-based waldur-ui library, and flatpickr is replaced by a react-day-picker calendar. This also replaces the earlier fix for the transparent flatpickr background. ScrollSpy navigation, the role permission field and chart export actions also move to shared components, and unused Metronic styles are removed.

since_previous.title: Notify only the offering managers of a proposal's requested offerings
since_previous.description: Proposal notifications for offering managers went to a broader group than the managers of the offerings the proposal requested. They now go only to managers of the requested offerings.

since_previous.title: Prepare Constance settings for replacement
since_previous.description: Previously, the site logo was stored as a Constance setting, and the LLM chat settings used their old Constance key names. Now, migrations remove the site logo Constance entry and rename the LLM chat Constance keys. Core and marketplace migrations are squashed, and the settings-related management commands (print_settings_description, set_constance_image, set_login_logo_language) are updated.

actions.description: Migrations core 0024_remove_constance_site_logo and 0025_rename_llm_chat_constance_keys update stored Constance values, and marketplace migrations are squashed.
Deployments that set the site logo or LLM chat Constance keys through scripts or configuration should check them against the renamed or removed keys.

since_previous.title: Remove proposal project duration and its review comment
since_previous.description: Previously, proposals had a project_duration field and reviews had a comment_project_duration field. Now, both fields are removed from the models, the API serializers, structure import/export and the call management demo preset. The UI no longer shows the project duration review comment.

actions.description: Migration proposal 0083_remove_project_duration drops Proposal.project_duration and Review.comment_project_duration, and their stored data.
API clients or integrations that read or write project_duration or comment_project_duration must be updated.

since_previous.title: Restrict what reviewers see of proposal teams and assignments
since_previous.description: The proposal team list ignored the call's applicant visibility setting for reviewers. It now applies that setting. Reviewers also see less about assignments that have not been sent yet or that have a conflict.

since_previous.title: Show OpenStack instance and tenant names in order tickets
since_previous.description: Previously, order tickets listed only the UUIDs of OpenStack instances and tenants. Now, their names are shown next to the UUIDs.

since_previous.title: Show providers the compliance checklist assigned to their offering
since_previous.description: Previously, service providers could not see the compliance checklist assigned to their offering. Now, the offering exposes the assigned checklist to its provider.

since_previous.title: Show readable qualifiers for same-named roles
since_previous.description: Previously, roles with the same name were told apart by machine names in role selectors. Now, readable qualifiers are shown instead, in invitations, project team, auto-provisioning and SRAM rule forms.

since_previous.title: Show the award confirmation prompt only to the applicant
since_previous.description: The award confirmation prompt in the proposal workflow timeline was shown to users other than the applicant. It is now shown only to the applicant.

since_previous.title: Show the impersonated user's token on /users/me again
since_previous.description: During impersonation, /users/me did not return the impersonated user's token. It now does again.

since_previous.title: Start a call's evaluation at the round cut-off and add call-manager controls
since_previous.description: Previously, a call's evaluation could not be configured to start at the round cut-off. Now, a call can be configured to start evaluation at the round cut-off. Call managers also get UI controls for the evaluation start, for resending reviewer invitations and for overriding reviewer workload limits on manual assignment.

actions.description: Migration proposal 0084_call_evaluation_start adds the evaluation start configuration to calls.

since_previous.title: Switch telemetry off from the Telemetry admin page
since_previous.description: Previously, telemetry sending could not be switched off from the Telemetry admin page. Now, the page has a control to turn it off.

since_previous.title: Validate offering option values for uniqueness and provider patterns
since_previous.description: Previously, offering options could not require unique values, and the UI did not check option values against the provider-configured pattern. Now, an offering option can require its values to be unique across the offering's resources. The order and option forms also check values against the provider's pattern.
